title: Wear app: Watch face settings menu (double-tab, settings) crashes Watch face when scrolling to the end.
symptom: Watch face settings menu (double-tab, settings) crashes when scrolling down to the end. After this sometime the watchface switches to 'black' and can only be restored by restarting the watch. After fully uninstalling and then reinstalling the wear app the problem temporary solves, but then after some time problem reappears.
fix: Fixed in latest dev version (3.0.0.2-dev-k 2022.05.12) and by commit be199719bd92ac85a6d32587a839f3f728591f20. If affected, you need to uninstall/install the wear app.
evidence_quote: fixed by https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/be199719bd92ac85a6d32587a839f3f728591f20 you need to uninstall/install if you are affected by this bug
